additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368554-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 160379906] Toggling IMD_BC1 CRM:00645000687
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
We have checked the logs and found 2 different errors regarding IMD recently. In first error, it shows IMD is not receiving Modbus values within 5 seconds and a mismatch between modbus and relay values.
Second error shows that the isoFault Rf value is less that 100 kOhm which triggers the fault error.
Please plan a site visit to check the IMD settings and all the connections to it. Also please carry one spare IMD with you in case a replacement is needed.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
